_readme: Fill-in file for learning/funding programs that cannot be scraped automatically
(e.g. Sayuj, or any other login-gated / encrypted-API platform).
HOW TO USE:
1. Log into the source platform yourself (e.g. https://sayuj.net).
2. Copy ONE JSON object per real program you see into the 'programs' array below.
3. Only copy what is actually shown on the page - never guess or invent a value.
Leave a field as "" (or remove it) if you cannot see that information.
4. Save the file, then run:  python -m scraper.learning_pipeline
(or wait for the next scheduled crawl / click Refresh on the dashboard).
5. Delete the '_example' entry below before your first real entry, or just
leave it - the loader skips any entry with "_example": true automatically.
FIELD REFERENCE (same shape scraper/learning_pipeline.py normalizes every
source into - see that file for the authoritative list of valid values):
title                 REQUIRED. Exact program/grant name.
provider              REQUIRED. Organisation running it, e.g. "Sayuj (STPI)".
official_url          REQUIRED. The exact page you saw this on (must start with http).
description           Copy the real description text. Leave "" if none shown.
application_url       The direct apply/enroll link, if different from official_url.
category              List from: EdTech, Programming, Game Development,
AI & Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, AR/VR/XR,
Web Development, Mobile Development, Cloud, DevOps, UI/UX,
Design, Business, Entrepreneurship, Digital Marketing, Finance,
STEM, Research, Career Development, Leadership, Language,
Skill Development.
subcategory           Free text, e.g. "Startup Grant".
program_type          One of: Course, Bootcamp, Fellowship, Scholarship, Training,
Certification, Workshop, Internship, Apprenticeship,
Mentorship, Academy, Degree/University, Research.
country               Where the program/organiser is based, e.g. "India".
city                  If shown.
location_type         One of: Online, Offline, Hybrid, Unknown.
eligible_countries     List of countries who can actually apply, e.g. ["India"].
cost_type              One of: FREE, PAID, SCHOLARSHIP, PARTIALLY_FUNDED,
FULLY_FUNDED, UNKNOWN.
price                  Number, only if a real fee is shown. Otherwise omit.
currency               e.g. "INR". Only if price is set.
funding_type           One of: NONE, SCHOLARSHIP, GRANT, STIPEND, FULLY_FUNDED,
PARTIALLY_FUNDED, UNKNOWN.
funding_amount         Free text, only if an actual amount is shown, e.g. "Rs 5,00,000".
certificate_available  true / false / "unknown" - only set true/false if the page
actually says so.
eligibility             Object, e.g. {"description": "Registered DPIIT startups only"}.
start_date              YYYY-MM-DD, only if shown.
end_date                YYYY-MM-DD, only if shown.
application_deadline    YYYY-MM-DD, only if shown.
source_type             GOVERNMENT / UNIVERSITY / INSTITUTION / COMPANY / PROVIDER /
SECONDARY. Sayuj is STPI (a Government of India society), so
GOVERNMENT is correct for Sayuj entries specifically.
(no 'source_name' field - it is set automatically to 'Manual Entries' so
that deleting a row from this file correctly removes it from the site on
the next crawl. 'provider' is what visitors see on the card.)

programs.title: Example: Idea to Startup Grant
programs.description: Paste the real description text you see on the program page here.

eligibility.description: Copy the real eligibility text here.
